stage.title: Implement platform external pass and multi-graph interop

goal: Support platform-command-list native custom GPU work outside RHICommandList, explicit raw RHI -> RenderGraph -> raw RHI sequencing, multiple RenderGraph instances in one frame, and allocator correctness across those boundaries without reintroducing hidden backend tracking.
entry_gate: The contract replacement checkpoint has frozen the external pass and interop boundary contract.
The barrier and queue synchronization checkpoint can lower API-neutral import/export and queue handoff intents.
The resource reuse checkpoint separates graph-local transient aliasing from global physical pooling.
The async record and submit checkpoint can submit compiled plans through RHIExecutor without a second RHI submission backend.

hard_rules.rule: Do not hide NVAPI, DirectML-style, or other platform-command-list native GPU work inside ordinary AddPass lambdas. Use an explicit external pass node.

Initial external passes must be PlatformCommandList passes. They declare resource access, native platform command-list handle capability, native resource handle capability, memory sharing mode, and queue type before Compile.
Raw RHI -> RenderGraph -> raw RHI sequencing must use import/export receipts with state, owner queue, and completion boundary. Do not depend on backend tracker side effects.
Do not transparently alias transient resources across independent RenderGraph instances. Compile one graph when cross-workload alias optimization is required.
RGGlobalResourcePool is shared through RGFrameContext and may only check out resources whose retire boundary is complete and whose pool key matches required native interop capabilities.
External native passes cannot access pooled or transient resources unless native handle stability, descriptor lifetime, and containing RHIExecutor completion tracking are all proven at compile time.
Do not support direct GPU runtime external passes with independent submit/sync in this milestone.

PlatformCommandList external callbacks are not executed by RenderGraph record tasks. RG record emits typed RHI platform callback commands, and backend visitors execute callbacks during translate/platform record.

checkpoints.title: Implement RGFrameContext and boundary receipts
checkpoints.problem: Raw RHI work, external native work, and multiple graph dispatches need a shared boundary owner. Without one, resource state would leak through backend trackers or global flushes.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: RGFrameContext stores frame sequence id, graph sequence ids, latest exported whole-resource state, owner queue, and completion boundary per resource.
Raw RHI submit receipts can be registered as graph import sources.
RenderGraph Dispatch publishes a receipt for exported resources and completion boundaries.
Importing an incomplete producer boundary creates an explicit wait or compile error.
The boundary model does not require a global Flush between raw RHI and RenderGraph work.

checkpoints.title: Implement explicit platform-command-list external pass nodes
checkpoints.problem: Native APIs such as NVAPI or DirectML-style command-list extensions may need GPU work that does not record through RHICommandList, but still records into the backend platform command list and has resource hazards.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: External passes use a separate AddExternalPass-style API and do not receive RHICommandList&.
Only PlatformCommandList external pass kind is accepted in the initial implementation.
External callbacks receive RGPlatformCommandListContext with the platform command-list handle and resolved native resource handles.
External pass setup uses the same explicit resource access declarations as normal passes.
Compile validates backend support for platform command-list handle, native resource handles, memory sharing mode, and command-list queue type.
External callbacks cannot allocate graph resources, mutate graph structure, submit RHICommandLists, or signal/wait independent GPU timelines.
RenderGraph record tasks do not execute external callbacks; they emit typed RHI platform callback commands.

checkpoints.title: Implement RHI platform callback command and segment barriers
checkpoints.problem: Platform-command-list external work needs a native command list that only exists during backend translate. RenderGraph must therefore emit a typed RHI command instead of executing the callback during graph record.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: External passes are graph nodes in dependency analysis and topological ordering.
Compile places each external pass into a command-list segment matching its queue type.
Compile emits barrier intents before and after external callbacks inside the containing command list.
RG record emits a typed RHI platform callback command between those barriers.
Backend translate/platform record executes the callback when the native command list and native resource handles are valid.
External pass completion is the containing RHIExecutor submit completion boundary.
Resource lifetimes extend through the containing RHIExecutor completion boundary before transient alias or pool return is allowed.

checkpoints.title: Support raw RHI before and after RenderGraph
checkpoints.problem: The renderer may need to issue raw RHI work, dispatch a graph, then continue with raw RHI work. That sequence must be explicit and must not require backend command scanning to rediscover state.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Raw RHI work before a graph exports resource state and completion boundary into RGFrameContext.
Graph imports from raw RHI receipts with explicit state and owner queue.
Graph exports can be consumed by later raw RHI command lists with no hidden tracker dependency.
Queue waits/signals are compiled at the boundary instead of forcing a device-wide flush.
Debug validation rejects raw RHI reuse of graph outputs without an export receipt.

checkpoints.title: Support multiple RenderGraph instances per frame
checkpoints.problem: Multiple systems may build separate graphs in one frame. They need safe sequencing and shared global pool access without cross-graph mutation of graph-local allocators.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Every graph in the frame is constructed with the same RGFrameContext.
Each graph owns its own setup allocator, compile allocator, scratch allocator, and transient alias allocator.
Graph A to graph B resource flow requires A export receipt and B import declaration.
Independent graphs can dispatch independently when they do not import each other's resources or contend for incomplete pooled resources.
Cross-graph transient aliasing remains unsupported unless those workloads are compiled as one graph.

checkpoints.title: Integrate allocator with interop boundaries
checkpoints.problem: Pooled and transient resources can be corrupted if an external native pass or another graph holds a resource past the allocator's assumed lifetime.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Global pool keys include platform-command-list native interop capability flags when resources can be used by external passes.
Pool checkout requires completed retire boundary, matching owner queue state, matching last known resource state handling, and matching interop capabilities.
Pool return waits for the containing RHIExecutor completion boundary before the resource is available again.
Transient allocator is graph-local and never lends physical slots to another RenderGraph instance.
Imported external resources remain excluded from transient aliasing and global pooling.

checkpoints.title: Add focused interop validation cases
checkpoints.problem: Interop bugs appear as stale resource state, missed waits, or allocator reuse before the containing command list completes. Focused cases must cover those boundaries directly.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Tests cover raw RHI -> RenderGraph -> raw RHI sequencing without device-wide flush.
Tests cover two RenderGraph instances in one frame with explicit export/import and independent dispatch.
Tests cover rejection of missing platform-command-list external pass capability data.
Tests cover allocator refusal to reuse resources before RHIExecutor completion boundaries retire.
Tests run through existing repository scripts.

stage_exit_gate: Platform-command-list external passes are explicit graph nodes with declared resources and native capabilities.
Raw RHI and RenderGraph exchange resources through receipts rather than hidden backend state.
Multiple RenderGraph instances in one frame share RGFrameContext and the global pool while keeping graph-local allocators isolated.
Allocator reuse waits on RHIExecutor completion for command lists that contain external passes.
validation: Run testscripts/windows/test_rhi_translate.ps1 after focused interop tests land.
Run testscripts/windows/test_all.ps1 after the stage-sized landing.
